text: **ADDED -- hv has RATIFIED the one deviation and the two strengthenings, which is a DIFFERENT ACT FROM VERIFICATION.** The R5 deviation (age Rust crate rather than shelled binary), S1 (posture refuses on the identity, warns on the store), S2 (material must not reach a rendering). **Verification says whether the design answers the requirements; ratification says whether a departure from them is accepted, and only hv can do the second.** hv is the same human on both boards, so this is one ruling and not two -- but it is not the same act as AC-00.16 and collapsing them is what produced the defect AC-00.16 now records.
